name: Christmas at Central National Bank
when_note: It runs over three weekends, with Friday afternoon and Saturday morning sessions, plus an extra Saturday afternoon session on December 19.
paras: Central National Bank hosts its 15th annual Christmas at Central National Bank at its Highway 84 location on six dates from December 4 to 19, 2026. Families get complimentary pictures with Santa, cookies and hot chocolate.

The bank plays holiday music and lights a 20 foot Christmas tree. A professional photographer takes the Santa pictures at no cost, and families may also use their own phones. The photos are posted to the bank's Facebook page, usually within 48 hours.
tip: Ask for the time slot card at the event, because it tells you which Facebook album holds your photos.
